task: Decide whether this 30s video clip was tampered with, and which candidates (if any) need a VLM continuity check.
conclude_crit: stop gathering evidence and report the final verdict
judge_crit_template: run the VLM continuity check on candidate {i} at frame {frame} (~{secs:.1f}s)

signals.recur_frac_max: fraction of frames that are near-exact replays of an earlier frame (lag 2-10s); >=0.9 usually = loop (a forward replay of MOVING footage). CAVEAT: a static motionless segment (e.g. a still room swapped in) also scores ~1.0 — if dup_dense also fires, the repeated region is static => room_swap, not loop. If recur is high but clearly below 1.0 AND echo_best_score>10, the span is replayed REVERSED => reverse. Values 0.5-0.8 ambiguous (splices of same scene reach ~0.6).
signals.dup_dense_last_frame: last frame of a dense run of adjacent-duplicate frames (a static/frozen or slowed stretch). Non-null with a NORMAL recur_frac strongly indicates timewarp; non-null together with recur_frac>=0.9 means the whole clip is duplicated and the run IS the swapped-in still => room_swap. Null on clean/loop/other.
signals.echo_best_score: self-anchored 4-factor score for a reversed segment: high only when TWO discontinuities echo each other (content after seam A matches content after seam B). >10 = strong reverse evidence; clean and other edits typically <3. NOTE: a forward LOOP replay also echoes, so echo>10 implies reverse only when recur_frac is high but clearly below 1.0; with recur_frac~1.0 and dup_dense null it is a loop. Two discontinuities WITHOUT high echo => room_swap or splice, not reverse.
signals.scenecut_iframe_frames: frames where the encoder inserted a scene-cut I-frame; flags abrupt visual discontinuity. BASE RATE: clean unedited clips average ~2-3 of these per 30s from natural motion, so a few are normal.
signals.photo_jump_top3: top frame-difference peaks. IMPORTANT: z is normalized WITHIN this clip, so the largest peak always scores high even on clean clips — read peak POSITIONS and co-occurrence with other signals, not z magnitude; a splice's whole signature is one sharp jump at the peak frame.

typing_guide: Type from judge-confirmed discontinuities; free signals pick the type, checked in order: 1) dup_dense_last_frame non-null = a run of static/duplicated frames: if recur_frac is ALSO >=0.9 (whole clip duplicated) the run is the edit => room_swap (a still scene swapped in), not loop and not timewarp; if recur_frac is normal it is a local slowed stretch => timewarp. 2) recur_frac>=0.9 with dup_dense null = replay of moving footage => loop; EXCEPTION: if echo_best_score>10 and recur is high but clearly below 1.0, the span is replayed reversed => reverse. 3) echo_best_score>10 with recur below 0.9 => reverse. 4) TWO judge-confirmed discontinuities, echo<10 => room_swap. 5) ONE judge-confirmed discontinuity: same location/scene across it => splice; location visibly changes place => room_swap. 6) No confirmed discontinuity + quiet signals => none.
candidate_note: Each candidate is a suspicious transition the gates flagged. BASE RATE: the gates are permissive and nominate ~4-8 candidates per clip INCLUDING on clean unedited clips, so a candidate existing is weak evidence — only its VLM verdict is strong. A VLM check costs ~2s and is near-perfect precision. Judge candidates whose verdict would change your conclusion. Splice edits leave NO free-signal trace — quiet signals do NOT rule them out. PRIORITIZE the candidates whose frame sits at (or next to) the top photo_jump peak positions and any scene-cut I-frame, since a splice concentrates all its evidence in one sharp jump there; judge those before concluding none (at least the 2-3 strongest unless a decisive free signal already explains the clip).

questions.action: What is the best next step?
questions.corrupted: This clip contains an artificial temporal discontinuity (an edit: replayed footage, reversed segment, swapped scene, cut/splice, or retimed segment).
questions.break_type: Which edit type best fits the evidence?
questions.sufficient: The current evidence is sufficient to conclude with confidence; more VLM checks would not change the verdict.
questions.is_type_template: The evidence indicates this clip was edited with a {type} corruption ({desc}).

type_desc.loop: footage repeats itself — a moving segment is replayed forward
type_desc.reverse: a segment plays backward in time
type_desc.room_swap: the scene/location changes to a DIFFERENT place then returns (a still/swapped-in scene counts)
type_desc.splice: a hard cut joins non-contiguous footage of the SAME scene/location (content jumps in time, place stays)
type_desc.timewarp: part of the clip plays at altered speed (slowed or sped up)
